LESSON: SAFE HANDLING OF ANIMALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Animal production
Topic 2.2: Safe handling of Animals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Safe handling of Animals, part of Animal production in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How does handling of animals affect their production and productivity? 2. How can we ensure safety when handling animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. examine forms of animal handling in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Safe handling of Animals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. describe the structures used to ensure safety in handling domestic animals,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Safe handling of Animals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. exhibit ways of ensuring safety of persons handling domestic animals,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Safe handling of Animals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Safe handling of Animals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: Learner develops active community life skills by promoting the rights of animals as enshrined in laws and

regulations.

● Communication and collaboration: learner develops speaking and teamwork skills when promoting animal safety in the

community.

Values

● Love: learner shows compassion by treating animals as sentient beings which should be protected from harm.

● Patriotism: learner appreciates the importance of carrying duties by observing laws and regulations governing handling of

animals and defending the animals against mistreatment.
